interview.secured: Day secured means you've completed your daily goal for the 7K Steps challenge and locked in your progress for today.
interview.freeze: The app never explained what a freeze is, so I can't say.
interview.selfReported: Self-reported means you manually entered or confirmed your step count yourself rather than it being automatically tracked.
interview.tomorrow: 8. The app made it easy to complete the challenge and showed clear progress, so I'd want to maintain my streak tomorrow.

goals.text: Open the challenge the app shows you, join it, finish today's task with Done and choose Post to friends. Note whether the post shows up in the feed.
